description: Source code for the RustProjectWriter class, responsible for generating rust-project.json files based on build targets, dependencies, and configurations within a build system. It includes functions for collecting dependencies, extracting compiler arguments, and rendering the JSON output.

classes.name: RustProjectWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for generating rust-project.json files from build targets.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFiles
methods.description: Generates the rust-project.json file based on build settings and targets.

methods.name: RenderJSON
methods.description: Main function to render the JSON structure for the rust project based on all targets.

methods.name: WriteCrates
methods.description: Serializes the list of crates into JSON format.

methods.name: AddTarget
methods.description: Adds a target and its dependencies to the crate list, collecting relevant info.

methods.name: GetRustDeps
methods.description: Recursively collects Rust dependencies for a target.

methods.name: ExtractCompilerArgs
methods.description: Extracts compiler arguments from a target.

methods.name: FindArgValue
methods.description: Finds the value of a specific argument in a list of compiler args.

methods.name: FindArgValueAfterPrefix
methods.description: Finds the value of an argument after a specific prefix.

methods.name: FindAllArgValuesAfterPrefix
methods.description: Finds all argument values after a specific prefix.
